_note: Pharmacy's own safety list. Used together with the AI check. 'a'/'b' are generic names or @group names from drug-groups.json. 'condition' words are looked for in the diagnosis/complaints. Advice must never tell people to stop or change a medicine on their own. MUST be reviewed by a pharmacist.

rules.what_happens: Together they greatly increase the risk of serious bleeding, including stomach bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Tell your doctor you take a blood thinner. Ask your pharmacist about a safer pain medicine.

rules.what_happens: Together they greatly increase the risk of serious bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Only take both if your doctor knows about both. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Two blood thinners together greatly increase the risk of serious bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Make sure your doctor knows you take both. Report black stools, blood in urine or unusual bruising at once.

rules.what_happens: This antibiotic makes the blood thinner much stronger, which can cause bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor may need to check your blood (INR) more often. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: The antifungal makes the blood thinner much stronger, which can cause bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor may need to check your blood (INR). Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: This antibiotic makes the blood thinner much stronger, which can cause bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor may need to check your blood (INR). Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: This antibiotic can make the blood thinner stronger and raise bleeding risk.
rules.what_to_do: Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding. Tell your doctor you take a blood thinner.

rules.what_happens: This antibiotic can make the blood thinner stronger and raise bleeding risk.
rules.what_to_do: Watch for unusual bruising or bleeding. Tell your doctor you take a blood thinner.

rules.what_happens: Taking paracetamol regularly for several days can make the blood thinner a little stronger.
rules.what_to_do: Occasional use is usually fine. Tell your doctor if you need it every day.

rules.what_happens: This stomach medicine can make clopidogrel work less well at protecting the heart.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor whether a different stomach medicine (such as pantoprazole) is better for you.

rules.what_happens: Together they raise the risk of bleeding, especially in the stomach.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your pharmacist about a safer pain medicine.

rules.what_happens: Together they raise the risk of bleeding. Heart doctors often give these two together on purpose.
rules.what_to_do: Take both only as your doctor told you. Report black stools or unusual bleeding.

rules.what_happens: Together they raise the risk of stomach bleeding, and some pain medicines can weaken aspirin's heart protection.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Together they raise the risk of stomach bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Report black stools or stomach pain. Ask your pharmacist about a safer pain medicine.

rules.what_happens: Together they raise the risk of stomach ulcers and bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Take with food. Ask your doctor whether you need a stomach-protecting medicine.

rules.what_happens: The antibiotic raises the cholesterol medicine to harmful levels, which can damage muscles.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together. Report muscle pain or weakness at once.

rules.what_happens: The antibiotic raises the level of the cholesterol medicine, which can cause muscle pain.
rules.what_to_do: Report muscle pain or weakness. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: The antifungal raises the level of the cholesterol medicine, which can cause muscle pain.
rules.what_to_do: Report muscle pain or weakness. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Amlodipine raises the level of simvastatin a little; high simvastatin doses can cause muscle pain.
rules.what_to_do: Usually fine at simvastatin 20 mg or less. Ask your pharmacist if your dose is higher.

rules.what_happens: Together they can cause a dangerous change in heart rhythm.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: The antibiotic can raise carbamazepine to harmful levels (dizziness, unsteadiness, drowsiness).
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Ciprofloxacin can raise theophylline to harmful levels (fast heartbeat, vomiting, fits).
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: The antibiotic can raise theophylline levels (nausea, fast heartbeat).
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: This combination can make blood pressure drop very low and cause extreme drowsiness.
rules.what_to_do: This combination is usually avoided. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Antacids, calcium, iron or zinc stop the antibiotic from being absorbed, so it may not work.
rules.what_to_do: Take the antibiotic 2 hours before or 6 hours after these medicines.

rules.what_happens: Antacids, calcium, iron or zinc stop the antibiotic from being absorbed, so it may not work.
rules.what_to_do: Take the antibiotic 2 to 3 hours apart from these medicines.

rules.what_happens: Calcium, iron and antacids reduce how much thyroid medicine the body absorbs.
rules.what_to_do: Take the thyroid medicine on an empty stomach, at least 4 hours apart from these.

rules.what_happens: Calcium reduces how much iron the body absorbs.
rules.what_to_do: Take them at least 2 hours apart.

rules.what_happens: Together they can raise blood potassium to dangerous levels, which affects the heart.
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor should check your blood potassium. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Two medicines that work the same way on blood pressure increase the risk of kidney problems and high potassium.
rules.what_to_do: This combination is usually avoided. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Pain medicines like these can weaken the blood pressure medicine and strain the kidneys.
rules.what_to_do: Use the pain medicine for the shortest time possible and drink enough water. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Pain medicines like these can weaken the water tablet and strain the kidneys.
rules.what_to_do: Use the pain medicine for the shortest time possible. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Together they can slow the heart too much.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: This medicine raises digoxin to harmful levels (nausea, slow or uneven heartbeat).
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor may need to lower the digoxin dose. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Together they can make blood pressure fall dangerously low.
rules.what_to_do: This combination is dangerous. Talk to your doctor before taking either medicine.

rules.what_happens: This medicine can raise lithium to harmful levels (shaking, confusion, vomiting).
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor may need to check your lithium level. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: This medicine can raise methotrexate to harmful levels.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Allopurinol can raise azathioprine to harmful levels that affect blood cells.
rules.what_to_do: Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Together they can cause serotonin syndrome (shaking, sweating, fever, confusion) and raise the risk of fits.
rules.what_to_do: Seek help urgently if these signs appear. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Together they can cause extreme sleepiness and slow, shallow breathing.
rules.what_to_do: Do not drive. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: Together they add to each other's drowsiness.
rules.what_to_do: Avoid driving or operating machinery.

rules.what_happens: Fluconazole can make the diabetes medicine stronger and cause low blood sugar.
rules.what_to_do: Check your sugar more often. Keep sugar or juice with you.

rules.what_happens: This antibiotic can make the diabetes medicine stronger and cause low blood sugar.
rules.what_to_do: Check your sugar more often. Keep sugar or juice with you.

rules.what_happens: This antibiotic can cause blood sugar to go too low or too high.
rules.what_to_do: Check your sugar more often while taking the antibiotic.

rules.what_happens: This blood pressure medicine can hide the warning signs of low blood sugar (shaking, fast heartbeat).
rules.what_to_do: Check your sugar regularly. Sweating may be the only warning sign.

rules.what_happens: Alcohol with this medicine causes severe vomiting, flushing, headache and fast heartbeat.
rules.what_to_do: Do not drink alcohol during the course and for 3 days after the last dose.

rules.what_happens: Alcohol with this medicine causes dangerous drowsiness and slowed breathing.
rules.what_to_do: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.

rules.what_happens: Alcohol with metformin can cause very low blood sugar and, rarely, a dangerous acid build-up.
rules.what_to_do: Avoid alcohol, especially heavy drinking.

rules.what_happens: Regular alcohol with paracetamol increases the risk of liver damage.
rules.what_to_do: Avoid alcohol and do not take more than the dose on the prescription.

rules.what_happens: Milk and dairy reduce how much of the antibiotic the body absorbs.
rules.what_to_do: Take it with water, 2 hours apart from milk, yogurt or cheese.

rules.what_happens: Milk or yogurt taken alone reduces how much of the antibiotic is absorbed.
rules.what_to_do: Take it with water, not with a glass of milk.

rules.what_happens: Large amounts of grapefruit juice raise the level of this cholesterol medicine.
rules.what_to_do: Avoid grapefruit juice.

rules.what_happens: These pain medicines can cause or worsen stomach ulcers and bleeding.
rules.what_to_do: Tell your doctor about your stomach problem. Ask whether a safer pain medicine is better.

rules.what_happens: These pain medicines can worsen kidney problems.
rules.what_to_do: Tell your doctor about your kidney problem. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.

rules.what_happens: In some people with asthma, these pain medicines can trigger an asthma attack.
rules.what_to_do: Get medical help at once if your breathing gets worse. Tell your doctor you have asthma.

rules.what_happens: This blood pressure medicine can tighten the airways and trigger breathing problems.
rules.what_to_do: Tell your doctor you have asthma or breathing problems.

rules.what_happens: Decongestants can raise blood pressure.
rules.what_to_do: Tell your doctor you have high blood pressure.

rules.what_happens: Metformin can build up and cause a dangerous acid problem when the kidneys are weak.
rules.what_to_do: Your doctor should check your kidney tests. Ask your doctor or pharmacist before taking these together.
